FN-KF8J55A-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 21
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/13/2024
Senate Bill 21 as introduced could decrease anticipated ad valorem tax receipts collected from
Class IV real property to the State General Fund, the Public School Fund, the Alabama
Historical Commission, the Veterans’ Assistance Fund, and county and municipal funds by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the current year's assessed value of Class IV real property
that may not exceed more than 3% of the assessed value of the previous year, pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.

Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/15/2024
REVISED

IV property to the following funds by the annual amounts listed by capping the growth in the
assessed value of Class IV property at no more than 3% of the assessed value of the previous
year, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
